text: Applicants for Master's degree: Hold a foreign ordinary passport, be in good health; possess a bachelor's degree or above; Applicants for doctoral studies: Hold a foreign ordinary passport, be in good health; possess a master's degree or above. 2. Language Proficiency: For applications with Chinese language instruction, a HSK 5 level score of 210 (inclusive) or a HSK 6 level score of 180 (inclusive) or above is required; those who have obtained a bachelor's or master's degree in Chinese language from a Chinese university can be exempted from submitting HSK scores. For applications with English language instruction, a TOEFL score of 80 (inclusive) or an IELTS score of 6.0 (inclusive) or a Duolingo score of 105 (inclusive) or above is required; applicants whose previous academic stage was taught in English or whose native language is English do not need to provide proof of English proficiency.
